title: Equivalent clean price
summary: Compare whether buying the product as purchased (with trim) or already clean is cheaper.

gross-price.label: Price as purchased
gross-price.placeholder: Price per kg as it comes, with trim (e.g. 10000)

supplier-clean-price.label: Clean product price
supplier-clean-price.placeholder: Price per kg the supplier charges already clean (e.g. 15000)

outputs.difference: Difference with the supplier's clean price

steps.equivalent-clean-price: Equivalent clean price = price as purchased × factor = {grossPrice} × {wasteFactor} = {equivalentCleanPrice}
